messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑Tamil Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **Tant'** | Intensifier indicating a high degree of bitterness | அதிகமாக | “very / so” | OK | | **è** (1st) | Copular verb linking subject “it” to predicate “bitter” | உள்ளது | “is” | OK | | **amara** | Predicate adjective describing the quality “bitter” | கசப்பாக | “bitterly” | OK | | **che** | Subordinator introducing the comparative clause | மற்றும் | “and” (used as a conjunction) | **WRONG** – does not convey the comparative “that” | | **poco** | Quantifier expressing a small amount | சிறிது | “little” | OK | | **è** (2nd) | Copular verb in the comparative clause | *(not expressed)* | — | **MISSING** | | **più** | Comparative marker “more” | அதிகம் | “more” | OK | | **morte** | Entity being compared – “death” | மரணம் | “death” | OK | | **ma** | Coordinating conjunction signalling contrast – “but” | ஆனால் | “but” | OK | | **per** | Prepositional marker of purpose (“in order to”) | *(not expressed)* | — | **MISSING** | | **trattar** | Infinitive “to treat” (purpose) | விவாதிக்க | “to discuss / treat” | OK | | **del** | Prepositional complement linking “good” to the verb | நல்லதைப் (part of) | “the good” (as object) | OK (implicit) | | **ben** | Direct object “good” | நல்லதைப் | “the good” | OK | | **ch'i'** (1st) | Relative pronoun “that I” (subject of clause) | *(implicit in “கண்ட”)* | — | **MISSING** | | **vi** | Locative adverb “there” | அங்கே | “there” | OK | | **trovai** | Verb “found” (completed action) | கண்ட | “found” | OK | | **dirò** | Main verb “will tell” (future intention) | சொல்லுவேன் | “will tell” | OK | | **de** | Prepositional marker “of/about” | *(not expressed)* | — | **MISSING** | | **l'** | Definite article “the” | *(embedded in “மற்றவற்றைச்”)* | — | OK (implicit) | | **altre** | Attribute “other” | மற்றவற்றை | “other (things)” | OK | | **cose** | Direct object “things” | மற்றவற்றை | “things” | OK | | **ch'i'** (2nd) | Relative pronoun “that I” (subject of clause) | *(implicit in “பார்த்த”)* | — | **MISSING** | | **v'** | Locative adverb “there” | அங்கே | “there” | OK | | **ho** | Auxiliary verb forming the perfect | *(not expressed)* | — | **MISSING** | | **scorte** | Main verb “seen” (perfect) | பார்த்த | “seen” | OK |
---
### Missing / Wrong Items - **Wrong:** `che` – rendered as “மற்றும்” (“and”) instead of a comparative subordinator. - **Missing:** `è` (second copula), `per`, `ch'i'` (both occurrences), `de`, `ho` – these grammatical elements are not overtly represented in the Tamil translation. - **Implicit/Embedded:** `del`, `l'` are absorbed into the Tamil compounds (`நல்லதைப்`, `மற்றவற்றைச்`) and therefore not separate lexical items.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Output per line: Line #, Original Translation, Issues, Corrected Translation (if any). Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

**Line # 1** - **Original Translation:** அதிகமாக கசப்பாக உள்ளது மற்றும் மரணம் சிறிது அதிகம்; - **Issues:** “che” rendered as “மற்றும்” (wrong); missing second copula “è”; comparative subordinator not expressed. - **Corrected Translation:** அதிகமாக கசப்பாக **என்று** மரணம் சிறிது அதிகம் **உள்ளது**;
**Line # 2** - **Original Translation:** ஆனால் நான் அங்கே கண்ட நல்லதைப் பற்றி விவாதிக்க, - **Issues:** “per” (purpose marker) not overtly expressed. - **Corrected Translation:** ஆனால் நான் அங்கே கண்ட நல்லதைப் **பற்றி** **விவாதிக்க**,
**Line # 3** - **Original Translation:** நான் அங்கே பார்த்த மற்றவற்றைச் சொல்லுவேன். - **Issues:** missing relative pronoun “ch’i’” and auxiliary “ho” (perfect). - **Corrected Translation:** நான் அங்கே **பார்த்துள்ள** மற்றவற்றைச் சொல்லுவேன்.
```text அதிகமாக கசப்பாக என்று மரணம் சிறிது அதிகம் உள்ளது; ஆனால் நான் அங்கே கண்ட நல்லதைப் பற்றி விவாதிக்க, நான் அங்கே பார்த்துள்ள மற்றவற்றைச் சொல்லுவேன். ```
